Build an ICU-assigned timeline from a native-grain harmonized table

Source: R/icu_timeline.R
make_icu_timeline.Rd

Projects a native-grain time-series table (usually ts_tab) onto ICU stays without modifying the canonical store. Source rows keep their native identifiers, including the source ICU stay ID when present. The derived table adds an assigned ICU stay ID, event-origin labels, ICU-time-relation labels, and a recomputed time_since_icu_min relative to the assigned ICU stay.

Usage

make_icu_timeline(
  src_name,
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  source_table = "ts_tab",
  out_table = "ts_icu",
  icustay_id = NULL,
  target_id = NULL,
  window_before_hours = 0,
  window_after_hours = 0,
  include_other_icu_events = FALSE,
  include_other_icu_stays = NULL,
  overlap = NULL,
  include_date_only_events = FALSE,
  date_time_since_icu = c("null", "zero", "event_anchor"),
  materialize = TRUE
)

Arguments

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo").

db_name

Optional Postgres database name; resolved from config if NULL.

base_dir

Project root directory.

source_table

Native-grain source table in the harmonized schema (default "ts_tab").

out_table

Output table/view name in the harmonized schema (default "ts_icu").

icustay_id

ICU stay identifier column. Defaults to the source ICU ID column from the dataset config (e.g. "stay_id" for MIMIC-IV).

target_id

Deprecated alias for icustay_id.

window_before_hours

Hours before ICU admission to include in each ICU analysis window.

window_after_hours

Hours after ICU discharge to include in each ICU analysis window.

include_other_icu_events

If TRUE, ICU-native events from other ICU stays in the same admission may be assigned to an ICU when they fall inside its analysis window. If FALSE, ICU-native events are only assigned to their own source ICU stay.

include_other_icu_stays

Deprecated alias for include_other_icu_events.

overlap

How to resolve a datetime event that lands in multiple ICU analysis windows: "first", "nearest", or "duplicate". If omitted, defaults to "duplicate" when include_other_icu_events = TRUE, otherwise "first". For "first" and "nearest", an eligible source ICU is preferred before temporal ordering. "first" then orders by ICU-window start, while "nearest" orders by distance to the ICU interval. ICU stay ID is the final deterministic tie-break.

include_date_only_events

If TRUE, date-only events are assigned to every ICU stay overlapping the same 24-hour admission-relative date.

date_time_since_icu

How to populate time_since_icu_min for assigned date-only events: "null" (default), "zero", or "event_anchor".

materialize

TRUE (default) builds a TABLE; FALSE builds a VIEW.

Value

Invisibly, the output object name ({schema}.{out_table}).

Details

This is intended for ICU-stay analysis and machine-learning datasets. For example, a hospital-level lab with no source ICU stay ID can be assigned to an ICU stay whose analysis window contains the lab time. If include_other_icu_events = TRUE, ICU-native events from neighboring ICU stays in the same admission can also be assigned when they fall inside the analysis window; the original source ICU stay ID is retained.

Date-only events are conservative by default. If include_date_only_events = TRUE, a date-only row is assigned to every ICU stay in the same admission whose ICU interval overlaps that 24-hour admission-relative date. Date-only assignment intentionally uses the raw ICU interval, not the padded window_before_hours/window_after_hours interval, and date-only rows are not deduplicated by overlap.

event_origin is one of "hospital", "same_icu", "other_icu", or "unassigned_icu". The last value means the source row had an ICU stay ID, but it was not assigned to an ICU timeline by the selected rules.

eICU is supported with the same semantics: its ICU windows are numeric minute offsets on the hospital-admission clock (admittime = 0) and its ts_tab carries a hospital-admission-relative time_since_hadm_min, so the same windowing and cross-stay assignment run, grouped on patienthealthsystemstayid instead of hadm_id.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
make_icu_timeline("mimic_iv_demo", db_name = "rendehr", window_before_hours = 6)
} # }
